title: Tiger cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d="M34 72 Q38 76 36 82" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 72 Q62 76 64 82" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 64 L50 70" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#FFE4B5"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="22" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d="M32 32 Q38 36 34 44" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 32 Q62 36 66 44" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 20 L50 28" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 22 Q46 26 44 30" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 22 Q54 26 56 30" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="24" r="9" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="24" r="5" fill="#FFB6C1"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="24" r="9" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="24" r="5" fill="#FFB6C1"/>
  <!-- face patches -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="48" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#FFE4B5"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="48" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#FFE4B5"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="40" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2E8B57"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="40" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2E8B57"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="39" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="39" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d="M46 48 L54 48 L50 53 Z" fill="#FF6B6B"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M50 53 Q47 58 44 56" stroke="#CC5500" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 53 Q53 58 56 56" stroke="#CC5500" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="28" y1="46" x2="38" y2="49" stroke="#CC5500" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="28" y1="52" x2="38" y2="52" stroke="#CC5500" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="46" x2="62" y2="49" stroke="#CC5500" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="52" x2="62" y2="52" stroke="#CC5500" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- left arm down -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="74" rx="7" ry="10" fill="#F5A623" transform="rotate(20 28 74)"/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="60" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#F5A623" transform="rotate(-30 76 60)"/>
  <!-- waving paw pad -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="50" r="6" fill="#FFE4B5"/>
  <!-- paw toe beans -->
  <circle cx="79" cy="46" r="2" fill="#FFB6C1"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="46" r="2" fill="#FFB6C1"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="43" r="2" fill="#FFB6C1"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="94" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="94" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#F5A623"/>
  <!-- foot pads -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="94" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FFE4B5"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="94" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FFE4B5"/>
</svg>
